decisions.statement: A line holds one property the page states, under the key the page states it as.
A line holds the value the page's body declares once that body has run.
The lines are sorted, so one property that changes moves one line.
A reader wanting one property reads one line rather than the whole page.
A page whose body will not load has a file with no line.
This file is written as the page lands, so nothing judges it against the page.
This file is written whole, so what it held before is never read to write it.
Reading a page's properties from here is far cheaper than loading its body.

definition: what a page carries, one line to a property
